text:
lucy: heads up — console chart load latency spiked in EU canary after yesterday's telemetry-proxy rollout. charts take ~400ms more on initial interaction. appears tied to initial data fetch + main-thread parse. anyone else seeing this? (metric: charts.lcp.p99 up ~20%)
ben: saw it in staging too. suspect the new telemetry bundle dragged in chart-utils v3 which duplicates plotlib. can we bisect quickly?
dion: +1. also noticed bundle size jump +62k gz. source map shows duplicated code paths in embedlib -> plot-utils and timezone-polyfill.
mike: routing team rolled a change to telemetry sampling default (eager:true) for canary to get more traces. that could increase payloads and change routing/bucket pressure. can revert if needed.
lucy: good catch. if we revert eager sampling we lose better traces. can we try toggling the flag on canary first and measure? also check kvcache miss rates.
tara: quick test — will set TELEMETRY_PROXY_EAGER=false on canary in 5m and run a synthetic user scenario.
lucy: also saw a spike in kvcache cold-misses at ~10:14 UTC — might explain extra main-thread work. tagging infra-bot for traces.
infra-bot: deployed patch TELEMETRY_PROXY_EAGER=false to canary:canary-3. rolling restart of browser-workers started. monitor: https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/123
ben: after toggling flag locally, p99 dropped ~180ms in a handful of runs. bundle parse still looks heavy though — stack traces show duplicate formatter functions: plot-utils.formatPoint and embedlib.formatPoint.
dion: found the root cause: webpack added embedlib as a separate entry in the splitpoint, causing duplicate chunk emission. I'll open PR to dedupe and convert the heavy formatter to a dynamic import so initial parse is smaller.
mike: added context — the routing weight tweak also bumped a small subset of chart requests into the lower-priority pool, causing backpressure and longer tail latencies. I'll revert the routing weight for the canary from 0.2 -> 0.1 now.
lucy: plan of record: (1) dion PR to remove duplicate entry + dynamic import for formatter, (2) mike revert routing weight, (3) tara validate telemetry flag and rerun p50/p99, (4) lucy will own postmortem if rollback becomes necessary. thanks all :thumbsup:
tara: quick validation: after revert + telemetry flag off, p50/p95/p99 look back to baseline in a 10-run sweep. will watch for 2h and report if anything bounces.
